verdict.rationale: Agents and teams built with AutoGen accept natural-language tasks, for example `agent.run(task="Find information on AutoGen")`. MagenticOne handles open-ended tasks, UserProxyAgent lets a human give feedback to the team, and AutoGen Studio offers an interactive environment for running teams. However, setting up and operating the product itself is done through Python code, JSON specs or drag-and-drop, not natural-language commands. Missing for 10: natural-language configuration and building of agents and teams, an NL-driven CLI or control surface, independent hands-on corroboration of NL-only operation.
